title: Close generated runtime resources on E2E failure
rootCause: The Factory E2E script created the production runtime but called runtime.close only after successful report persistence, so validation, resume loading, stage execution, and report-write failures could bypass closure.

resourceOwnership.creator: createProductionFactoryRuntime in the Factory E2E script
resourceOwnership.owner: scripts/factory-e2e-smoke.ts for the duration of one invocation
resourceOwnership.cleanupOwner: withRuntimeLifecycle at the script-owned terminal boundary
resourceOwnership.lifetime: From successful runtime creation through validation, resume/stage execution, and report persistence
resourceOwnership.cleanupTrigger: Every terminal resolution or rejection of the post-creation operation

defectReproduction.preCorrection: The baseline source created runtime at the post-preflight boundary and placed runtime.close after report persistence without try/finally. A controlled post-creation operation failure makes that close statement unreachable; no real provider-backed E2E was invoked.
defectReproduction.postCorrection: The deterministic lifecycle fixture forces a post-creation operation failure and observes one close call while preserving the original error; the success fixture observes one close call and the successful result.

lifecycleBefore.use: validate runtime, load optional resume report, run E2E stages, persist report
lifecycleBefore.release: runtime.close only after successful report persistence

lifecycleAfter.use: The existing validation, resume, stage, and report behavior is unchanged inside the operation callback
lifecycleAfter.release: withRuntimeLifecycle awaits runtime.close in finally for success and failure
lifecycleAfter.failureBehavior: The original failure propagates after the owned runtime is closed

successCleanup: Runtime closes once after successful report persistence; success output and release eligibility are preserved.
failureCleanup: Runtime closes once after validation, resume loading, stage execution, or report persistence failure; the outer safe failure report remains responsible for process status.
cancellationCleanup: No separate script cancellation signal is currently passed to the real E2E harness. If the operation rejects for cancellation or abort in a future bounded path, the same finally boundary closes the runtime. No AI-generation timeout was introduced.
retryCleanup: No new retry mechanism was introduced. Resume/retry work remains inside the same owned runtime boundary and cannot bypass its terminal close.
processCleanup: Not applicable to this finding. The created production runtime's implemented close contract ends its PostgreSQL pool; this correction does not add process scanning or global termination.
childProcessBehavior: No child process is created by the corrected runtime-close boundary.
processTreeBehavior: Not applicable; no process tree is owned by this boundary.
portBehavior: Not applicable; no temporary local server or port is created by this boundary.
browserBehavior: Not applicable; browser, context, and page ownership remains with the existing Functional QA service.
lockBehavior: Not applicable; no workspace lock is created by this boundary.
tempWorkspaceBehavior: Not applicable to the assigned finding; generated workspace lifecycle remains outside cg-07.
customerProjectSafety: Customer projects and customer artifacts are untouched.
filesystemCleanup: Not applicable to this finding. No recursive filesystem cleanup was added.
pathSafety: No cleanup path was introduced; customer roots, promoted versions, debug workspaces, and unknown directories are untouched.
ownershipMarker: Not applicable; no filesystem resource is auto-cleaned by cg-07.
filesystemRetry: Not applicable; no filesystem deletion was introduced.
cleanupIdempotency: The lifecycle wrapper invokes the runtime close operation exactly once for each terminal operation path.
rollbackCriteria: Not represented in the machine group contract; the bounded correction is reversible by reverting correction commit 247babe.
historicalTempCleanupDecision: NOT_AUTHORIZED: the cg-07 machine contract concerns the Factory E2E runtime close boundary and explicitly excludes QA workspace cleanup.

scopeJustification.reason: The lifecycle helper is the smallest bounded terminal boundary and its test provides deterministic success/failure proof; the verifier extension is required Phase 6 administrative infrastructure for the two assigned reviewer rechecks.

correctionSummary: Wrapped the existing post-creation Factory E2E operation in an awaited try/finally lifecycle helper so the production runtime closes on all terminal paths without changing E2E scenarios or adding timeout policy.
testsAdded: Success lifecycle test preserves the operation result and closes once.
Failure lifecycle test preserves the original post-creation error and closes once.
